experiments.paper_location: Section 4.4; sparse neural network module (training support)
experiments.mechanism: Active-set Softmax and batch-averaged multi-label deltas with the slide-in shared-memory layout.

conditions.execution: CPU serial emulation of selected actual CUDA bodies
conditions.oracle: Independent double-precision dense W*x+b and max-subtracted active-set normalization, retaining denominator EPS=1e-8; each variant is checked against expected probabilities and deltas.
conditions.labels: nonempty, unique, and contained in active outputs

experiments.note: All three Softmax layouts, including all_sm, are checked against the independent oracle. Maintained MAX_INIT=-FLT_MAX is exercised by large negative shifts. Scalar block_max/block_reduce, host math intrinsics and serial atomics do not validate CUDA warp reductions, parallel shared memory, launch dispatch or full Network::train. See docs/g-slide/softmax.md.
